label.description: The label for the textarea. If provided, renders a label element associated with the control.

id.description: A unique identifier for the textarea, used to associate the label and for accessibility.

name.description: name attribute for the textarea. Defaults to id.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text displayed inside the textarea when empty.

error.description: An error message (string) to display when invalid, or `true` to mark the control as errored without a message.

success.description: A success message (string) to display when valid, or `true` to mark the control as successful without a message.

disabled.description: Disables the textarea, preventing user interaction.

hint.description: Hint text for additional guidance. Rendered as a span and referenced by `aria-describedby`.

screenReaderOnlyLabel.description: Visually hides the label while keeping it accessible to screen readers.

formGroup.description: Whether to wrap the label/hint/error/control in a `.usa-form-group`. Set to `false` when composing inside another form group.

className.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the textarea.
